sloka: नित्यं श्रेयसि सम्मूढं महद्भिर्व्यसनैर्वृतम् ।हन्यात्कस्तादृशं लोकं जराव्याधिशतैर्युतम् ।। ७.२०.९ ॥
transliteration: nityaṁ śreyasi sammūḍhaṁ mahadbhirvyasanairvṛtam ।hanyātkastādṛśaṁ lokaṁ jarāvyādhiśatairyutam ।। 7.20.9 ॥

translations.english: It is not proper for you, who are invincible to gods, danavas, daityas, yakshas, gandharvas, and rakshasas, to torment the human world.
